newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Telecel to maintain investment in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Telecel to maintain investment in 1997.

text.p: Portugese mobile phone operator Telecel will hold investment levels steady in 1997, compared with 1996, while average revenue per customer will fall more than in recent years, the company's president said.

Average monthly revenues per client fell four percent to 17,233 escudos in 1996, compared with 1995, and should fall further in 1997 due to the impact of a planned reduction in prices to be announced in March, Antonio Carrapatoso said.

"The average revenue per client will fall by more in 1997 than in recent years, especially because of the drop in prices and the greater weighting of families among our clients," he told a news conference.
Carapatoso's remarks followed the announcement of a 1996 net profit of 7.3 billion escudos, up from 2.4 billion in 1995.
Telecel said it spent 14.8 billion escudos on investment in 1996, 31 percent more than in 1995.
Carrapatoso said Telecel cut its debt by 9.1 percent in 1996, compared with 1995, to 15.9 billion escudos.
